reason: I'd just prompt a model myself or hand it to the team or a freelancer I already trust. Paying 55 USDC for a contest where most entries go unpaid isn't how I buy small jobs.
objection: Why not just use ChatGPT, or hire the one freelancer I already trust? Plus I'd have to fund in USDC on Solana, with a brand-new, unaudited product judged by an AI I don't know.
would_change_my_mind: A free first task where the winning entry clearly beats what I get from a model in ten minutes, with no crypto setup on my side.
